question: GQ-007
subject: moving the language check from after the download to before it
last_turn: found six German/Latin books in the corpus and reported them. Detection after the bytes have moved is a report, not a filter.

the_signal_available_at_selection.ia_language_field: says eng for all six — useless
the_signal_available_at_selection.the_title: "für Geschichte und Literärgeschichte", "Zeitschrift", "Johannis Freind medicinae doctoris"

the_rule.german: any one function word — für, und, der, zeitschrift, geschichte...
the_rule.latin: TWO or more markers, because "de" and "ad" appear in English titles alone
the_rule.why_two: a single-marker Latin rule would flag "A brief sketch of the Historical Club of the Department of Medicine"

where_it_lives_now: build-want-list.mjs, with the excluded items recorded in the want-list under non_english_excluded
why_that_matters: the exclusion is written into the artifact with its reason, so a future reader sees WHAT was dropped and WHY rather than a smaller number
the_six_already_in_the_corpus: left in place. Removing books is not this filter's job, and corpus-integrity still reports them.
